strengths: I like the current design.  The header and menu is anchored, the background is lowcountry, the color palette is solid.
The current information architecture is solid - Home, Services, About, Gallery, Blog, Contact, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service.
The Home Page is good - Layout and design is solid.
The About Us page - I love the personal touch, this is very important in the Lowcountry
The Blog page is great for freshness of content and seo, the 2 existing posts are great topics and covered well.
The Contact Us page has all the needed contact details and a simple form to fill out
Most of the images on the site are webp format, which is the best format for performance reasons for web images.
The images and CSS on the site are cached
Pages have lightweight and subdued microinteractions on the site, which is good. The engage the customer without being overwhelming.

LocalBusiness and Organization schema are emitted on home page, which is great for LLMS and AI search indexing.  I also see that your facebook account is listed in the sameAs section. This sends signals to SEO / AEO bots that you have content in all those places, and you are connected.
There is a sitemap.xml file with the basic site pages listed
robots.txt is present and wide open, allowing search engines to crawl anything on the site
llms.txt is also present, but very brief
areasForImprovement: The only thing I would consider changing about the design of the site is a minor change to the usage of the logo.  It looks to be AI Generated, which is not a problem in itself.  But AI does not consider usage when coming up with a design. There are a lot of small details in the logo, so I would have a version for small spaces (like the header/menu) that drops out the small details so it remains bold and readable.  There are also times where you may want a more horizontal version of the logo such as business card, letterhead, maybe even the header / menu.  So I would come up with a horizontal version as well.  Then you would have 3 versions of your logo you can use at the right time - a full version, a small version, and a horizontal version.
Most of the content on the home page should be a teaser to more content onto other, deeper pages.
It seems the favicon is present, but not working
About Us page - the One Trusted Team photo has something weird going on inside it. It looks like text is leaking out of it and misshapen a bit.
The Gallery is empty, this needs at least stock photos for now, or hidden until complete.
There is no FAQs page, and this is critical for LLMs / AEO
There is a services page, but not individual pages for each individual service.  This is a missed opportunity for SEO / AEO
There are also no service areas listing page and detail pages for each individual service area.  Another missed opportunity for SEO / AEO
There is no legal / terms of service / privacy policy page - they go to 404.  This should be fixed quickly, as this is probably already indexed this way by Google.
You look to have implemented a basic analytics service (possibly from GoDaddy) on the page.  I recommend wiring up Google Analytics instead.  It is free, and the gold standard for the industry.
You should also create a Google Search Console profile to see how your site is indexed, particularly as you add / remove / improve your pages
Google Page Speed is good, but the metric for Largest Contentful Paint indicates the pages could use some help to improve.
There seem to be some React errors in the console.  You should track those down and see if that is due to anything within your control.
The Blog does not emit a Blog or Article schema for AEO.  Can GoDaddy do that?
It seems that caching is not enabled for your HTML documents or for fonts.  You should investigate how to do that on GoDaddy.

The logo is a large image, the biggest on the page.  It is also a PNG format but doesn't seem to be transparent.  I recommend a WebP format instead, like all the other images.  Then remove the white background around the edges.  This will improve performance and may be the cause of the lower LCP score.
The site does not emit any of these files.  While they are less critical, it impacts the user experience and findability.
The following files are missing: llms-full.txt, rss.xml, manifest, sitemap.json, humans.txt, security.txt, ai.txt, browserconfig.xml
